scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy --prefix worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix worker && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.migrate:local: npm run migrate:local --prefix ../payments && npm run migrate:local --prefix worker
scripts.dev:split: concurrently -n pagos,app -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix ../payments" "wrangler dev -c worker/wrangler.toml --persist-to ../.dev-state --var PAYMENTS_URL:http://localhost:8788"
